# Game Idea: Asteroid Escape

A minimal HTML canvas game where the player controls a small ship at the bottom of the screen, moving left and right to dodge falling asteroids. Asteroids spawn at random positions and speeds from the top and fall toward the bottom. The player can collect occasional power‑ups for temporary shields or speed boosts. **Lose condition:** The game ends immediately when the ship collides with any asteroid.

Goal: Survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score.

<content>
1: // Minimal Asteroid Escape game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){console.error('Canvas #game not found');return;}
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   function playTone(freq, duration){
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration/1000);
19:     osc.start(now);
20:     osc.stop(now + duration/1000);
21:   }
22:   function scoreSound(){ playTone(600, 80); }
23:   function collisionSound(){ playTone(200, 200); }
24: 
25:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
26:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
27: 
28:   // Player ship (triangle)
29:   const ship = {w:40, h:20, x:width/2-20, y:height-30, speed:5};
30:   // Generate background stars
31:   const stars = Array.from({length:100},()=>({
32:     x: Math.random()*width,
33:     y: Math.random()*height,
34:     r: Math.random()*2+1
35:   }));
36:   const ship = {w:40, h:20, x:width/2-20, y:height-30, speed:5};
37:   const keys = {left:false,right:false};
38: 
39:   // Asteroids
40:   const asteroids = [];
41:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
42:   let lastSpawn = 0;
43: 
44:   // Score
45:   let score = 0;
46:   let gameOver = false;
47: 
48:   // Input handling
49:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=true; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=true;});
50:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')keys.left=false; if(e.key==='ArrowRight')keys.right=false;});
51: 
52:   function spawnAsteroid(){
53:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
54:     const speed = 2 + Math.random()*3;
55:     asteroids.push({x:Math.random()*(width-size), y:-size, w:size, h:size, speed});
56:   }
57: 
58:   function update(dt){
59:     if(gameOver) return;
60:     // move ship
61:     if(keys.left) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
62:     if(keys.right) ship.x = Math.min(width-ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
63:     // move stars (parallax background)
64:     for(let s of stars){
65:       s.y += 0.5; // slow downward drift
66:       if(s.y > height){ s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random()*width; }
67:     }
68:     // spawn asteroids
69:     if(Date.now()-lastSpawn>asteroidSpawnInterval){spawnAsteroid(); lastSpawn=Date.now();}
70:     // move asteroids
71:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
72:       const a = asteroids[i];
73:       a.y += a.speed;
74:       // remove off‑screen
75:       if(a.y>height){asteroids.splice(i,1); score++; scoreSound();}
76:       // collision
77:       if(a.x < ship.x+ship.w && a.x+a.w > ship.x && a.y < ship.y+ship.h && a.y+a.h > ship.y){
78:         gameOver=true; collisionSound(); break;
79:       }
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   function render(){
84:     // space background gradient
85:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,height);
86:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#000020');
87:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#000010');
88:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
89:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
90:     // stars (draw before ship/asteroids)
91:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
92:     stars.forEach(s=>{ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); });
93:     // ship (triangle)
94:     ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
95:     ctx.beginPath();
96:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
97:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y);
98:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
99:     ctx.closePath();
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // asteroids with radial gradient
102:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{
103:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x+a.w/2, a.y+a.h/2, a.w*0.2, a.x+a.w/2, a.y+a.h/2, a.w/2);
104:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777777');
105:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222222');
106:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
107:       ctx.beginPath();
108:       ctx.arc(a.x+a.w/2, a.y+a.h/2, a.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
109:       ctx.fill();
110:     });
111:     // score
112:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
113:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
114:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,10,20);
115:     // game over overlay
116:     if(gameOver){
117:       ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
118:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
119:       ctx.fillStyle='white';
120:       ctx.textAlign='center';
121:       ctx.font='32px sans-serif';
122:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
123:     }
124:   }
125:   }
126: 
127:   let lastTime=0;
128:   function loop(ts){
129:     const dt=ts-lastTime; lastTime=ts;
130:     update(dt);
131:     render();
132:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
133:   }
134:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
135: })();

(End of file - total 135 lines)
</content>
